```python
'''
This file contains the implementation of a number guessing game with a GUI using tkinter. 
The game generates a random number, and the user tries to guess it, receiving hints (higher/lower) until they guess correctly.
'''
import tkinter as tk
import random
class NumberGuessingGame:
    def __init__(self, master):
        '''
        Initialize the game with GUI components and game variables.
        '''
        self.master = master
        self.master.title("Number Guessing Game")
        self.label = tk.Label(master, text="Guess the number between 1 and 100")
        self.label.pack()
        self.entry = tk.Entry(master)
        self.entry.pack()
        self.guess_button = tk.Button(master, text="Guess", command=self.check_guess)
        self.guess_button.pack()
        self.status_label = tk.Label(master, text="")
        self.status_label.pack()
        self.start_game()
    def start_game(self):
        '''
        Start a new game by generating a random number and resetting the game state.
        '''
        self.random_number = generate_random_number(1, 100)
        self.entry.delete(0, tk.END)
        self.status_label.config(text="")
    def check_guess(self):
        '''
        Check the user's guess against the generated number and provide feedback.
        '''
        try:
            guess = int(self.entry.get())
            if guess < self.random_number:
                self.update_status("Higher!")
            elif guess > self.random_number:
                self.update_status("Lower!")
            else:
                self.update_status("Congratulations! You've guessed it!")
                self.start_game()
        except ValueError:
            self.update_status("Please enter a valid number.")
    def update_status(self, message):
        '''
        Update the status label with a message.
        '''
        self.status_label.config(text=message)
def generate_random_number(start, end):
    '''
    Generate a random number between start and end.
    '''
    return random.randint(start, end)
if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    game = NumberGuessingGame(root)
    root.mainloop()
```
